title: Jenderal di Atas Atap
genre: Indonesian late-80s slow rock power ballad
subject: a man in Tanah Abang keeping six chickens on his rooftop whose rooster Jenderal crows from the water tank at four every morning and wakes the whole gang, until the bubur seller thanks him for never being late
caption: Indonesian late-80s slow rock power ballad revival. Singing overdriven lead guitar with long sustained bends and a solo, big gated-reverb drums, glassy DX7-style electric piano chords, picked bass, string-synth pad. Glossy late-80s studio rock sound, big reverb, wide stereo guitars. Male high tenor rock voice with long vibrato and dramatic held notes. 72 BPM, C# minor. Mock-heroic, exasperated, then fond. No autotune, no trap drums, no modern pop production, no rap, no metal blast beats.
lyrics:
[Intro - electric piano and guitar bend, drums crash in]

[Verse 1]
Di atap rumah di Tanah Abang
Enam ayam kupelihara
Lima betina bertelur pelan
Satu jago, namanya Jenderal

[Pre-Chorus]
Jam empat pagi dia berdiri
Di atas tandon air

[Chorus]
Jenderal, Jenderal, pelankan suaramu
Satu gang bangun karena kamu
Bu RT ketuk pintu rumahku
Jenderal, belum subuh, tahu

[Verse 2]
Kututup kandang pakai sarung
Kuputar radio pelan-pelan
Dia diam, aku tidur lagi
Jam empat lewat, dia berkokok lagi

[Bridge - guitar solo, then voice]
Tukang bubur bilang terima kasih
Berkat Jenderal dia nggak telat

[Chorus]
Jenderal, Jenderal, teruskan suaramu
Gerobak bubur jalan karena kamu
Bu RT masih marah padaku
Tapi minta telurnya satu

[Outro - long guitar sustain, drums fade]
